description: Buy often and pay the full balance almost every month; carry almost no balance.
recommended_action: Rewards and premium card upgrades; little interest income, so keep them through value, not price.

description: High credit limits and the largest purchases, but use only a small part of their limit.
recommended_action: Spend-based offers and instalment plans for large purchases; good candidates for retention efforts.

description: Small balances and occasional small purchases; the card isn't their main one.
recommended_action: Activation campaigns (first-purchase bonus, digital wallet set-up); review dormant accounts.

description: The highest balances: they buy regularly, take cash advances and carry a balance.
recommended_action: Most profitable but exposed; balance-transfer and instalment offers, with close credit monitoring.

description: Low limits used almost to the maximum, carrying a balance month to month.
recommended_action: Early-warning monitoring and payment-plan outreach; review before any limit increase.

description: Rarely buy anything; use the card mainly to withdraw cash, at high interest.
recommended_action: Offer lower-cost alternatives (personal loan, overdraft); monitor for financial stress.
